FLOOD HAZARD AREA DEVELOPMENT PERMIT APPLICATION Application is hereby made for a DEVELOPMENT PERMIT as required by the Special Purpose Flood Damage Reduction Resolution No. 11-06-12-1 of Pickaway County, Ohio, for development in an identified flood hazard area. All activities shall be completed in accordance with the requirements of said regulations. The development to be performed is described below and in attachments hereto.
